tools.name: infantry_usage
tools.description: Plan usage per meter and the pacing allowance.

config.title: Mock usage data
config.applies: Applies to: the usage and limits shown everywhere (Usage panel, meters, usage_get, the limits frame).

fields.label: Show mock usage data
fields.description: Show mock usage data instead of real readings: for demos, screenshots and testing. Env: INFANTRY_USAGE_MOCK=1.

fields.label: Mock data (JSON)
fields.description: Provider id to percents: {"claude":{"session":18,"week":42,"monthly":7,"weekResetsInMinutes":3000}}. Resets are relative to now. No accounts or emails. Empty or unreadable = the default shown here.

fields.label: Mock also drives pacing
fields.description: Off (default): pacing and the usage governor keep judging the REAL usage, so faked screenshots never buy extra workers. On: pacing judges the mock.
